name: RoboBPP
description: Physical feasibility in 3D bin packing is a key requirement in modern industrial logistics and robotic automation. With the growing adoption of industrial automation, online bin packing has gained increasing attention. However, inconsistencies in problem settings, test datasets, and evaluation metrics have hindered progress in the field, and there is a lack of a comprehensive benchmarking system. Direct testing on real hardware is costly, and building a realistic simulation environment is also challenging. To address these limitations, we introduce RoboBPP, a benchmarking system designed for robotic online bin packing. RoboBPP integrates a physics-based simulator to assess physical feasibility. In our simulation environment, we introduce a robotic arm and boxes at real-world scales to replicate real industrial packing workflows. reputation: A very recent, specialized robotics benchmark that is not yet broadly adopted, but it addresses an important practical gap in robotic online bin packing evaluation.
notes: Likely small and highly specialized; performance depends on simulator fidelity and task setup, and it is not an LLM benchmark.
